text.“단순한 브랜드 네이밍이 아닌, 빌더의 철학이 담긴 언어 츠바사(TSUB: “TSUBASA is not simply a brand name but a word that carries the builder's philosophy. Meaning ‘wing’, it captures what a bicycle truly is. The feeling in the saddle created by feather-light weight and remarkable responsiveness, together with Tsubasa's own texture, raises cycling to the level of contemporary art.”
text.깃털처럼 가벼운 로드바이크: A road bike as light as a feather
text.빌더가 직접 제작한 카본 튜브와 3D 프린팅 티타늄 드롭아웃을 사용한 비: A bespoke carbon road bike frameset with carbon tubes made by the builder himself and 3D-printed titanium dropouts. 820–860g (size 56).
text.사막의 비단결같은 모래는 아름다움과 냉혹함 사이에서 자신의 존재감을 드러: Silken desert sand reveals its presence somewhere between beauty and harshness. The character of the Tsubasa Crow brings that duality of desert sand straight into cycling. A Helvetica logo, clean character lines and a texture all its own combine to express the Crow's resolute attitude.
text.시판 자전거에서는 볼 수 없는 츠바사 바이시클의 카본 패턴은 사이클리스트: Tsubasa's carbon pattern, unseen on production bikes, captivates cyclists. Edvinas, the designer of Tsubasa Bicycles, perfects the textured surface through a finely judged blend of carbon and resin.
text.엔비 In-Route / 콜롬부스 푸투라 디스크 / 콜롬부스 트리티코: ENVE In-Route / Columbus Futura Disc / Columbus Tritico
text.자이언트, 메리다, 스페셜라이즈드, 트랙 등 전 세계 시장에서 판매가 진: Most carbon fiber frames sold around the world, from Giant, Merida, Specialized, Trek and others, are built on the idea of mass production. The Tsubasa Crow starts instead from personalization. Alongside the core qualities of a handmade bike, remarkable stiffness and feather-light weight, the Crow's raw surface texture and custom paint options make an inviting canvas for a rider's individuality.
text.츠바사 바이시클 코리아 | Tsubasa Bicycles 공식 수입원: Tsubasa Bicycles Korea | Official Tsubasa Bicycles importer
text.츠바사 바이시클을 대표하는 모델, 츠바사 크로우(Tsubasa Crow): The Tsubasa Crow, the signature model of Tsubasa Bicycles, pursues a single proposition: speed.
text.츠바사 바이시클의 대표이자 프레임빌더인 에드비나스는 동양과 서양의 경계에: Edvinas, founder and frame builder of Tsubasa Bicycles, stands on the border between East and West. Born in the Soviet Union and living as an immigrant in London, his journey found its completion when he met his wife, a Korean-Japanese ceramic artist.

Edvinas, founder and frame builder of Tsubasa Bicycles, stands on the border between East and West. Born in the Soviet Union and living as an immigrant in London, his journey found its completion when he met his wife, a Korean-Japanese ceramic artist. That is why the beauty of the border between East and West shows through in the Tsubasa Crow.
text.츠바사 바이시클의 바이크빌더, 에드비나스(Edvinas)는 브랜드의 시작: Edvinas, the bike builder of Tsubasa Bicycles, is the beginning and end of the brand. A former architecture student in London, he turns a pure passion for cycling into something remarkable.

Edvinas, the bike builder of Tsubasa Bicycles, is the beginning and end of the brand. A former architecture student in London, he turns a pure passion for cycling into something remarkable. His exceptional feel for materials and a broad experience that spans many cultures raise the bicycle from a means of transport to a work of art.
text.츠바사 바이시클의 비스포크 바이크 빌더인 에드비나스(Edvinas)는 까: Edvinas, the bespoke bike builder of Tsubasa Bicycles, took his inspiration from the crow's sharp intelligence, its sleek silhouette and the lightness of its black feathers. A finesse you won't find on production bikes is the essence of the Tsubasa Crow.
text.츠바사 바이시클의 전위적인 애티튜드는 츠바사 타키온 MASS 프로토타입을: The avant-garde attitude of Tsubasa Bicycles takes visible form in the Tsubasa Takhion MASS prototype. Its composition of striking straight lines expresses the purity of the bicycle and points to the horizon Tsubasa Bicycles is heading for.
text.츠바사 바이시클의 초경량 로드바이크 츠바사 크로우를 정의하는 가장 중요한: The most important word in defining the Tsubasa Crow, the ultralight road bike from Tsubasa Bicycles, is weight. Tsubasa's owner Edvinas fine-tunes the ratio of prepreg and resin, the raw materials of a carbon road bike, so that not a single gram is wasted. It is a detail made possible because one builder handles both the design and the making of each frame.
text.츠바사 바이시클이 가진 감성적 접근은 동양과 서양에 대한 폭넓은 이해에서: The emotional approach of Tsubasa Bicycles comes from a broad understanding of both East and West. The name comes from the Japanese word for ‘wing’ (tsubasa). It expresses the brand's pursuit of feather-like lightness, and carries the brand's essence across past and present, East and West, function and beauty.
text.츠바사 크로우, 깃털같은 가벼움: Tsubasa Crow, light as a feather
text.츠바사 크로우는 림브레이크와 함께 디스크 브레이크 옵션도 함께 제공합니다: The Tsubasa Crow is offered with rim brakes or as a disc brake option. Lightweight carbon components from THM Carbones of Germany, Partington, the premium disc wheel brand that combines performance and low weight, and ENVE Composites, with its wide riding spectrum: Rubi Workshop works directly with a range of component brands for riders who choose the Crow.
text.츠바사 크로우의 카본 튜브는 빌더의 손으로 직접 제작합니다. 각각의 튜브: The Tsubasa Crow's carbon tubes are made by the builder's own hands. Each tube carries the Crow's distinctive carbon pattern and raw, three-dimensional texture, and is reborn as a frame fitted to the rider's style and geometry. The rear brake bridge and the dropouts that hold the rear derailleur are titanium.
text.츠바사 타키온 MASS 프로토타입 측면: Tsubasa Takhion MASS prototype, side view

text.카본 파이버가 지닌 순수함, 깃털처럼 가벼운 로드바이크, 건축과 사이클링: The purity of carbon fiber, a road bike as light as a feather, where architecture meets cycling.
text.카본 파이버의 시대로의 전환은 프레임 빌더들에게 놀라운 기회의 장을 선사: The move into the carbon fiber era opened a remarkable field of opportunity for frame builders. Free from the fixed properties of steel and aluminum, carbon fiber lets a builder create strength, compliance and shape at will, and it has become a canvas that holds the builder's imagination as it is.
text.튜빙의 설계와 지오메트리 그리고 페인팅까지, 루비워크샵과 함께 나만의 츠: From tube design and geometry to paint, complete your own Tsubasa Crow with Rubi Workshop. Build the perfect Crow with premium parts offered exclusively by Rubi Workshop and the finest service and assembly from our Engineer Bar. Tsubasa completes your premium cycling lifestyle.
text.한국계 일본인인 에드비나스의 아내의 이야기는 일제 강점기때로 거슬러 올라: The story of Edvinas's wife, a Korean-Japanese, goes back to the Japanese colonial period. Born into a family taken to Japan through forced labor, she absorbed many cultures as she moved between Korea, Japan, Hong Kong and Britain. Edvinas, born in the Soviet Union, grew up witnessing the scars of Cold War states on his way from Lithuania in Eastern Europe to Britain.
